## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed photographic activity during November 2019. A total of 459 people were photographed during the reporting month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the planned operating arrangements.

The activity level reflects the work undertaken by the clinic during the month. The available information indicates that sessions proceeded routinely, with the exception noted above.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent, representing 8 image sets. These images could not be graded and are included in the reported ungradable total. The result provides a summary measure of image quality for the activity completed during November 2019.

## Grading

A total of 64 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This records the central grading interval for the month and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality measures reported above. Overall, the site’s activity, image quality and grading results are presented for routine operational review.
